use default
use Raster.ANIMATION
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

struct VEC(x: double, y: double) is
    +(other: VEC) -> VEC => VEC(x + other.x, y + other.y)
    -(other: VEC) -> VEC => VEC(x - other.x, y - other.y)
    *(k: double) -> VEC => VEC(x * k, y * k)

    length: double => Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y)

    limited(low: double, high: double) -> VEC =>
        if length > high then
            self * (high / length)
        elif length < low /\ length > 0.0D then
            self * (low / length)
        else
            self
        fi
si

class BOID is
    position: VEC public
    velocity: VEC public

    init(position: VEC, velocity: VEC) is
        self.position = position
        self.velocity = velocity
    si
si

let cave = IO.File.read_all_lines("cave.txt")

let columns = cave[0].length
let rows = cave.count
let width = cast double(columns)
let height = 2.0D * cast double(rows)

let frames = 240
let sight = 6.0D
let personal_space = 1.5D

row_of(y: double) -> int => rows - 1 - cast int(Math.floor(y / 2.0D))

column_of(x: double) -> int =>
    (cast int(Math.floor(x)) % columns + columns) % columns

is_wall(point: VEC) -> bool =>
    point.y < 0.0D \/ point.y >= height \/
    cave[row_of(point.y)][column_of(point.x)] == '#'

wall_push(point: VEC) -> VEC is
    let push mut = VEC(0.0D, 0.0D)

    for dx in -3::3 do
        for dy in -6::6 do
            let probe = point + VEC(cast double(dx), cast double(dy))

            if is_wall(probe) then
                let away = point - probe
                let distance = Math.max(away.length, 0.5D)

                push = push + away * Math.pow(distance, -3.0D)
            fi
        od
    od

    push
si

steer(boid: BOID, flock: List[BOID]) -> VEC is
    let near =
        flock
            |> filter(other =>
                !(other == boid) /\
                (other.position - boid.position).length < sight)
            |> collect_list()

    let force mut = VEC(0.04D, 0.0D) + wall_push(boid.position) * 1.5D

    if near.count > 0 then
        let n = cast double(near.count)

        let centre =
            near |> map(o => o.position)
                |> reduce(VEC(0.0D, 0.0D), (a, b) => a + b)

        let heading =
            near |> map(o => o.velocity)
                |> reduce(VEC(0.0D, 0.0D), (a, b) => a + b)

        let crowding =
            near
                |> filter(o =>
                    (o.position - boid.position).length < personal_space)
                |> map(o => boid.position - o.position)
                |> reduce(VEC(0.0D, 0.0D), (a, b) => a + b)

        force = force +
            (centre * (1.0D / n) - boid.position) * 0.01D +
            (heading * (1.0D / n) - boid.velocity) * 0.05D +
            crowding * 0.1D
    fi

    force
si

move(boid: BOID, flock: List[BOID]) -> bool is
    boid.velocity = (boid.velocity + steer(boid, flock)).limited(0.4D, 0.8D)

    let next = boid.position + boid.velocity

    if is_wall(next) then
        boid.velocity = boid.velocity * -0.5D
        return false
    fi

    let wrapped = next.x >= width

    boid.position =
        if wrapped then VEC(next.x - width, next.y) else next fi

    wrapped
si

draw(image: IMAGE, flock: List[BOID]) is
    image.clear(235ub, 240ub, 245ub)
    image.colour(90ub, 80ub, 70ub)

    for (row, line) in cave |> index() do
        for (column, c) in line |> index() do
            if c == '#' then
                let x = cast double(column)
                let y = height - 2.0D * cast double(row + 1)

                image.fill_rectangle(
                    x - 0.05D, y - 0.05D, x + 1.05D, y + 2.05D)
            fi
        od
    od

    image.colour(200ub, 40ub, 40ub)

    for boid in flock do
        image.dot(boid.position.x, boid.position.y, 2.0D)
    od
si

cave |> each(line => write_line(line))
write_line("")

let random = System.Random(1)

let flock =
    cave
        |> index()
        |> flat_map(r =>
            r.value
                |> index()
                |> filter(c => c.value == 'O')
                |> map(c => VEC(
                    cast double(c.index) + 0.5D,
                    height - 2.0D * cast double(r.index) - 1.0D)))
        |> map(position => BOID(
            position,
            VEC(0.3D, random.next_double() * 0.4D - 0.2D)))
        |> collect_list()

let image = IMAGE(240, 90)

image.view(0.0D, 0.0D, width, height)

let animation = ANIMATION(240, 90)
let crossings mut = 0
let bumps mut = 0

for _ in 0..frames do
    draw(image, flock)
    animation.add(image, 40)

    for boid in flock do
        if move(boid, flock) then
            crossings = crossings + 1
        fi
    od

    bumps = bumps +
        (flock |> filter(boid => is_wall(boid.position)) |> count())
od

write_line("{flock.count} boids, {frames} frames")
write_line("{crossings} crossings of the cave")
write_line("{bumps} boids found inside a wall")

animation.write("boids.png")

animation.show("boids.png")
